meta.title: HMAC challenge-response handshake
meta.subtitle: Protocol v2, four frames, and a token that never crosses the wire

messages.label: HELLO {agent_id, agent_name, protocol_version:2}
messages.note: The console resolves the token first. An unknown identity is refused before any nonce is issued.

messages.label: CHALLENGE {nonce}
messages.note: 16 fresh random bytes, hex-encoded to 32 characters. The nonce is single-use: the console consumes it on the first answer.

messages.label: CHALLENGE {nonce, hmac_response}
messages.note: The agent signs the 16 raw nonce bytes with HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the provisioned token. The token never crosses the wire.

messages.label: AUTH_OK {}
messages.note: The console recomputes and compares in constant time. Only on equality does it acknowledge; every failure is ERR auth_failed.

cards.title: What the Handshake Buys
items: No command traffic can flow before the session is authenticated
A wrong token cannot be brute-forced online: each attempt consumes the nonce
An unknown identity is refused before any challenge is issued

cards.title: Refusal Taxonomy
items: Every failure becomes ERR with code auth_failed
The specific reason travels as prose in the message field
AUTH_OK is never sent after a failure
